title: What If the Sea Rose a Foot by 2050? It's Already Planned

scenes.text: What if the sea rose one foot in 25 years? Scientists say it already will.
A 2022 federal report says US coasts will rise ten to twelve inches by 2050.
That is as much rise as the last hundred years combined, squeezed into about thirty.
Moderate flooding would hit more than ten times as often as it does today.
A town that floods once every two to five years could flood several times a year.
No storm needed. Plain high tides alone would flood streets that stay dry today.

description:
What if the sea rose a foot by 2050?
